values.note: Lots 1-12 full hookup (30 A; lots 9 and 10 are 50 A), lots 13-35 water and electric; all pull-through. Rustic camping elsewhere on the 37 acres.

sites.source: https://www.michihistrigan.com/ ('All Sites are "PULL THROUGH"'; lots 1-12 and 13-35 as quoted for hookups; 'Our 37-acre amazing grounds are also available for rustic camping'), read 2026-10-22. The stored 32-ft maximum rests only on directory listings and the operator states none, so it is cleared.

facilities.source: https://www.michihistrigan.com/pricing ('Pricing for DUMP Station: $25 per dump'), read 2026-10-22. The operator's pages mention showers only in the cabins and say nothing of a campground bathhouse, laundry or store; those stored values came from the sweep note (directory listings), so they are cleared.

values.note: 'For Bookings and Appointments, Please call this number directly (906) 477-6983'; the site also has a 'Request a Reservation' message form. No online booking engine.

booking.source: https://www.michihistrigan.com/seasonal-camping/gould-city-mi ('For Bookings and Appointments, Please call this number directly (906) 477-6983'; 'Request a Reservation'), read 2026-10-22

note: Byce's Michihistrigan Campground, Bar and Cabins: a 37-acre wooded campground attached to a bar & grill in Gould City, on snowmobile trail #2; tent and rustic camping, six cabins, stone pavilion, disc golf. Directory listings (not the operator) describe restrooms, showers, laundry and a store, mini golf, archery and trout ponds, and a season of about May 1-Dec 1. Nightly transient plus some seasonal. --Claude
summary: Operator site (current for 2026): W/E $30, FHU $35, rustic $20 (undated pricing page), 35 pull-through lots (1-12 full hookup, 9-10 50 A; 13-35 W/E), dump station, phone bookings. Fees confirmed with a source (now manual); hookups/pull-through/dump/booking confirmed; count 35 added. Cleared directory-only max 32 ft, showers, laundry, store. Season (derived, year_round false) left: the operator states no season. Seasonal camping is offered but its share is not published. No gateway within 40 km (Pictured Rocks 76 km); price under US$50 anyway. Phone and website match.
flags: Seasonal share unknown: the operator advertises seasonal camping ('plant yourself in one place for months') beside posted nightly rates for 35 lots, but publishes no count of seasonal sites. Not long-stay in character on the evidence; posted nightly price and phone booking pass the presence/price rule.
Price gate: base $30/night (water/electric) on the operator's pricing page, under US$50.
